title: Trust Readiness Dashboard for the Onyx RAG Project
subtitle: Onyx is the governed RAG runtime. Trust is the security, policy, evidence, telemetry, and launch-readiness layer around it.
hero_copy: The dashboard proves whether Onyx can safely launch. It leads with decision, blockers, required action, and evidence mode, then shows the RAG proof chain and launch-gate evidence.
landing_steps: Confirm trust proof freshness and completeness
Review the top failing or missing security control
Open drill-down sections for detailed evidence
repo_description_suggestion: Decision-first Trust readiness dashboard for governed Onyx RAG launch approval.
